notes.title: Baptised into Christ’s death
notes.intro: Paul describes baptism as being buried with Christ and raised to new life.

views.label: Baptism truly unites us with Christ’s death and resurrection
views.summary: Sacramental traditions see baptism as the act by which God joins a person to Christ.

views.label: Baptism signifies and seals union with Christ
views.summary: Reformed Christians see baptism as a sign and seal of union with Christ, received by faith.

views.label: Immersion pictures burial and resurrection
views.summary: Baptists and others see the burial imagery as showing that baptism should be by immersion, symbolising a change already received by faith.
views.source: Baptist Faith and Message (2000), Article VII
